scripts.dev: concurrently --names BE,FE --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --names BE,FE --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm start -w backend" "npm start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.dev:app: concurrently --names BE,APP --prefix-colors magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm --prefix mobile run start"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names BE,FE,APP --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm --prefix mobile run start"
